question.text: At $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$, the solubility produet of salt of $\mathrm{MX}_{2}$ type is $3.2 \times 10^{-8}$ in water. The solubility (in $\mathrm{mol} / \mathrm{L})$ of $M X_{2}$ in water at the sume temperature will be

solution.text:
For $M X_{2}$ type salt,
Solubility product, $K_{\mathrm{sp}}=4 s^{3} ; 3.2 \times 10^{-8}=4 \mathrm{s}^{3}$
or $s=\sqrt[3]{\frac{3.2 \times 10^{-8}}{4}}=2 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{mol} / \mathrm{L}$
